public_rationale: The Markup’s March 29, 2024 report documents New York City’s public chatbot operating and repeatedly giving materially incorrect guidance, including answers about housing vouchers and workers’ tips [e1]. These documented failures support the criticism of the city’s 2024 experience [e1].
limitations: The documented tests do not establish a representative overall error rate.
The evidence does not show whether users acted on the incorrect guidance or suffered harm.
The March 2024 tests do not establish the service’s reliability in later periods.

our_interpretation: The context identifies a public government chatbot offering unreliable answers.
I read the understated criticism as alleging material answer-quality failures, not merely an absence of exceptional performance.
I interpret 'about year ago' as the 2024 experience with the service, rather than an exact launch anniversary.
criteria.support_condition: Records show that New York City operated the public chatbot during 2024 and that it repeatedly supplied materially inaccurate guidance.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Records establish that no such service operated in the period, or reliable examination refutes the alleged material answer failures.
